scope: Cycle 01 starts from the owner-accepted complete main foundation. Historical changes are included in the baseline; missing individual performance attribution remains unknown, not unaccepted.

changes.change: Quiesce the APU before snapshot load

incremental.correctness: Old baseline reproduced a DSP assertion; repaired candidate completed Morrowind snapshot cells on OpenGL and Vulkan
incremental.performance: unavailable: old baseline failed readiness; no causal timing percentage established

cumulative.performance: Included in the initial baseline. No separate cumulative optimization gain claimed.

foundation.includes: All existing main source, fixes, tests and diagnostics at this exact commit
foundation.historical_attribution: Preserved commit/PR/evidence inventory; no inferred per-patch performance gain
foundation.cycle_start_delta: Same source and binary for main versus baseline: no implementation delta, not a newly measured 0% benchmark

normalization.incremental: No product source, build, test or runtime-setting change
normalization.cumulative: Product source remains identical to baseline; no new measured performance percentage
normalization.cycle_alignment: Initial main and baseline are identical at baseline/cycle-01-start. Future accepted PRs advance main without moving baseline.
